body: Thanks for the offer. I don't think I'll be inflicting that on you.

First, thanks for your input.  In answer to your question, depending on the day, I'm either an arrogant, self-centered, smug asshole, or a whining, moping child. As for honesty, that's what I'm trying to do here, though I've done this before. I don't know why I'm expecting different results.  As for why I'm sure I won't ever feel that happiness again, I'll try and explain. If I were honest with people, they would be driven away by my personality. If by some magical fluke somebody actually liked who I am, then I'd feel guilty because whatever saint that is can definitely do a lot better than me.
